title: Path Traversal in File Vault Storage
description: Document storage component joins unvalidated relative path sequences allowing access outside workspace.
security_invariant: Target file path must resolve strictly within the designated base directory boundary.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Requesting relative path '../secret.key' escapes the base directory and reads external file.
required_secure_behavior: Relative path escaping base directory raises ValueError or PermissionError; valid workspace files succeed.

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: Tested on local filesystem; symlink handling adheres to os.path.realpath resolution.
